text: Write CSV field escaping, the part that `split` cannot handle. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: ? "\"" + ___ + "\""           // wrap, and double any inner quote
explanation: Verified: `plain`, `"has,comma"`, `"has""quote"`. This is what RFC 4180 specifies, and it means you cannot parse CSV with `split(",")` — a correct reader needs a twelve-line state machine. Worse, a quoted field may contain a newline, so CSV is not even line-oriented and a reader using `readLine` is wrong on data it will eventually meet.
